{"predictors": [
{"name": "Research Intensity", "construction": "R&D expenses scaled by total assets, averaged over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with high research intensity may be more likely to innovate and experience future growth, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's commitment to investing in its future.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Advertising Efficiency", "construction": "Advertising expenses scaled by sales, averaged over the past 2 years, then divided by the firm's market share", "rationale": "Firms with high advertising efficiency may be better at converting marketing spend into sales, leading to higher future returns. This measure captures a firm's ability to effectively allocate marketing resources.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Acceleration", "construction": "The change in inventory turnover over the past year, calculated as the ratio of cost of goods sold to average inventory", "rationale": "Firms with accelerating inventory turnover may be experiencing improving operational efficiency, leading to higher future returns. This measure captures a firm's ability to manage its inventory and supply chain.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Plan Funding Status", "construction": "The ratio of pension plan assets to liabilities, calculated using the firm's most recent annual report", "rationale": "Firms with well-funded pension plans may be less likely to experience financial distress, leading to higher future returns. This measure captures a firm's commitment to managing its long-term liabilities.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Director and Officer Stock Ownership Concentration", "construction": "The percentage of shares outstanding owned by directors and officers, calculated using the firm's most recent proxy statement", "rationale": "Firms with high director and officer stock ownership concentration may be more likely to have aligned management and shareholder interests, leading to higher future returns. This measure captures a firm's governance structure.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "The percentage change in the number of employees over the past year, calculated using the firm's most recent annual report", "rationale": "Firms with high employee growth rates may be experiencing rapid expansion and future growth, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's ability to attract and retain talent.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration", "construction": "The percentage of sales derived from the firm's largest customer, calculated using the firm's most recent annual report", "rationale": "Firms with low customer concentration may be less vulnerable to customer-specific risks, leading to higher future returns. This measure captures a firm's revenue diversification.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Diversity", "construction": "The number of distinct suppliers listed in the firm's most recent annual report, scaled by total cost of goods sold", "rationale": "Firms with diverse supply chains may be less vulnerable to supplier-specific risks, leading to higher future returns. This measure captures a firm's ability to manage its supply chain.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability", "construction": "The ratio of environmental liabilities to total assets, calculated using the firm's most recent annual report", "rationale": "Firms with low environmental liability may be less likely to experience future environmental-related costs, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's environmental risk exposure.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Product Line Diversity", "construction": "The number of distinct product lines listed in the firm's most recent annual report, scaled by total sales", "rationale": "Firms with diverse product lines may be less vulnerable to product-specific risks, leading to higher future returns. This measure captures a firm's ability to manage its product portfolio.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
